dossiers.supersessionGap: Early-2025 opening was an expectation in the 10-K, not a retrieved confirmation. Original Jewel arrangement is preserved as the former brand.

dossiers.evidenceSnippet: The 2025 integrated report lists InHouse León and states a lease. One passage dates InHouse leases for the León and Ciudad Obregón select-service hotels on 31 May 2023 and 11 December 2023 respectively. A later note says the León lease was signed on 11 December 2023. Those execution dates conflict, so no commencement date is stored.
dossiers.supersessionGap: Lease expiration, renewal, and notice terms were not disclosed. Current brand listing does not prove the original lease text is unamended.

dossiers.evidenceSnippet: The report says the Ciudad Obregón select-service hotel reopened under an InHouse lease on 23 August 2023, while the paired 'respectively' sentence would date that lease on 11 December 2023. Execution date is conflicted and is not stored. The 2025 portfolio still lists InHouse Cd. Obregón.
dossiers.supersessionGap: Expiration not disclosed.

dossiers.evidenceSnippet: Fiesta Americana Condesa Cancún is identified among hotels whose contract is a lease (arrendamiento); the operator manages energy and water costs. Commencement, expiration, and the named lessee for this hotel were not stated in that passage.
dossiers.supersessionGap: No expiration or amendment date disclosed.
dossiers.hpcName: Fiesta Americana Condesa Cancun All Inclusive

dossiers.evidenceSnippet: Gamma Tijuana closed in August 2025 for repositioning. The 2025 report says it opened as Hilton Garden Inn Tijuana Aeropuerto in March 2026. The filing does not state whether the Hilton arrangement is franchise or management.
dossiers.supersessionGap: Franchise versus management was not stated, so no contract row is written.

dossiers.evidenceSnippet: Atlantica announced on 5 July 2021 that Comfort Suites Oscar Freire, São Paulo, would operate as Quality Suites Oscar Freire. Atlantica's current hotel page still lists Quality Suites Oscar Freire at Rua Oscar Freire 1948. No franchise expiration was disclosed.
dossiers.supersessionGap: 2021 announcement has no term, renewal, or termination clause. Current brand page does not disclose the contract expiration.

staged.evidenceSnippet: Hyatt's 30 June 2025 release: 50-year management agreements for 13 of 15 Playa owned resorts, with two properties under separate arrangements. The release does not assign the 50-year term to named hotels.

staged.hotelName: Service Properties Trust — one IHG-managed hotel (unnamed)
staged.evidenceSnippet: As of 30 September 2025 the IHG management agreement for one hotel expires on 31 January 2026, with a one-year extension option. The hotel is not named. Discussions of a potential extension are not a completed extension.

staged.hotelName: Service Properties Trust — Hyatt portfolio (17 hotels)
staged.evidenceSnippet: Hyatt managed 17 select-service hotels under a portfolio management agreement expiring 31 March 2031. Individual hotel names and hotel-level expirations are not in the note.

staged.hotelName: IHG UK disposal — 73 hotels / 20-year management on 63 core hotels
staged.evidenceSnippet: IHG 6-K dated 10 March 2005: sale of 73 UK hotels. The core 63 were to remain IHG-managed and branded under 20-year management contracts with two 5-year extension options. Hotel names are not listed. Source vintage is 2005; later supersession was not retrieved.

staged.hotelName: FibraHotel operator portfolio (Posadas, Marriott, Aimbridge, Click, InHouse)
staged.evidenceSnippet: As of 31 December 2025 FibraHotel reported hotel operating contracts with Grupo Posadas, Grupo Real Turismo, Operadora Marriott, Aimbridge, and Click Efficiency, plus leases. Counts are portfolio-level. Hotel-level expirations are not in that passage. The credit-line maturity in the same report is loan maturity and is not a hotel contract expiration.
